gate_a.stop: Stop before collection/training if either count is below 32/40

gate_b.stop: Stop before training/final collection if Bayesian count is below 160/200

selection: fixed final optimizer step, no label-based model selection
go_rule: GO only if hierarchical minus flat mean cluster accuracy >= 0.05 AND paired training-seed Student-t 95% lower bound > 0 AND hierarchical mean overall prediction MSE < flat; otherwise NO-GO
mapping: train-only standardization/PCA16/KMeans5; Hungarian and fixed-C logistic probe use development labels only
representation: mean and std over all causal state steps of each episode; no onset or true label selects a state
signatures: autocorrelation time in steps; event-aligned error; inner iterations vs own surprise and condition
sensory_channels: gripper xyz, wrist force xyz, perceived target xyz, mean other-object xyz, gripper opening, target velocity xyz, mean other-object velocity xyz (19); actions 4; holding+phase 10
given: Privileged object entity tokens via the default CameraFramePerception; learned arm world model and standard MPPI. No RGB decoder.
